result.title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
result.summary: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇以任务为中心的长文档视觉问答综述，把任务拆为文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、评测四个部分，给出细粒度分类并梳理各组件动机、技术回应与演化脉络，最后展望证据充分性、可验证与可纠正理解以及预算感知协调等方向。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「证据充分性」「证据管理与检索筛选」「预算感知协调」与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡、视觉证据筛选问题直接相关，可作为定位相关工作的框架参照；但属综述且不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，具体论断需核查原文。
